# Claudia Velazco - Asesora Inmobiliaria RE/MAX Eleva (Maracaibo, Venezuela)

> Claudia Velazco is a bilingual (Spanish/English) real estate advisor with RE/MAX Eleva in Maracaibo, Zulia, Venezuela. She helps clients buy, sell and invest in real estate in Maracaibo and across Venezuela, with special focus on Venezuelans living abroad who want to invest or move back, and on foreign investors.

## Key facts
- Name: Claudia Lorena Velazco Pirela
- Role: Real estate advisor (asesora inmobiliaria) at RE/MAX Eleva
- Location: Maracaibo, Zulia, Venezuela; serves all of Venezuela

## Services
- Selling property in Maracaibo and Venezuela
- Buying property, including for clients abroad (via registered or apostilled power of attorney)
- Real estate investment advisory
- Remote transactions for the Venezuelan diaspora (video tours, document handling, written reports)

## Listings
Current properties (updated weekly): https://cvenezuelaproperties.com/propiedades (Spanish) | https://cvenezuelaproperties.com/properties (English)
